These are deterministic, noncoding software QA sequences generated by
`scripts/benchmark-blast.py` using Python Random(1729), not biological traits.
The sequences and test annotations are dedicated to the public domain (CC0).
`qa.tar.gz` contains all five files produced by NCBI formatdb 2.2.26 -p F -o T.
`missing.tar.gz` deliberately omits the two ID indices to reproduce the old bug.
`unindexed.tar.gz` is a valid three-file formatdb -o F database.
The expected JSON was calculated independently from native blastall 2.2.26 XML
by the Python benchmark, without importing the application parser. It includes
forward/reverse, multi-contig, negative, insertion/deletion, duplicate subject,
and exact/below-coverage boundary controls. The same queries are supplied as
plain FASTA and gzip to verify the advertised upload formats.
